item.title: HAPPY TIMES Is, “Comic Gold!” – Grouchy Editor
item.description: “Happy Times came as a pleasant surprise…I was consistently amused and often delighted by the family members, whose hang-ups range from mild neurosis to full-blown psychopathy. It’s impossible to predict which of them will snap at a moment’s notice; more than once, I lost track of who had offed (or apparently offed) whom. […]

item.title: Movie Jawn: HAPPY TIMES Is, “Over-the-Top, Funny, Gory”
item.description: “Mayer seems to be having giddy fun finding inventive ways of dispatching the guests. Characters employ crossbows, a kiln(!), and even a garbage disposal to commit murder. item.title: HAPPY TIMES Is, “Smart, Fast-Paced, Violent Fun”
item.description: “There’s plenty of bold, bloody brutality to be found here, but made palatable by a witty screenplay, amusing characters and a playful tone.
